relationships.name: Article → source
relationships.reason: The source catalog is canonical; each article also embeds the small publisher snapshot used to render it without a lookup.
relationships.alternative: Remove the snapshot and fetch the publisher record by sourceId at read time, reducing duplication but adding a lookup.

relationships.name: Article → threat assessment
relationships.reason: The analyst verdict is bounded and consumed with the article, so it lives in sourceAssessment on that article.
relationships.alternative: A separate assessment collection could provide a central history, but displaying the verdict would require another query or lookup.

relationships.name: Indicators → article/source provenance
relationships.reason: An indicator can recur in many reports and is independently searchable and updateable.
relationships.alternative: Embed a bounded indicator snapshot on each article; this helps article detail reads but makes cross-report IOC search and consistency harder.

relationships.name: Annual reports → publisher
relationships.reason: The source list is externally maintained and reports are stored with their publisher name and URL.
relationships.alternative: A separate publisher collection avoids repeating publisher metadata but requires lookups.
